info.title: LibreFinance — native Nextcloud application APIs
info.description: Original AGPL application contracts. Structural response schemas are provisional and require full OCS/OpenAPI extractor adoption. Every route enforces Nextcloud identity and per-space roles. MCP is read-only; AI is consented.
